title: 04/19/19 - Software Updates
content:
## 04/19/19 - Software Updates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000056695

We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the H1 element on member search results pages to show unexpected text in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Member Feature Search Results H1

- The "Promo Discount" text in the Order Summary on Checkout pages is now a Text Label. New Text label: promo_discount_label.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the General Settings page in the Admin from saving when the Members-Only Content Add-On was de-activated on a site in some cases.

- The "Hide Reviews Star Rating Options" Product Setting will now hide the Review Stars on Review Search Results pages and Member Profile pages. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Read Review Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Submit Review Feature Involved: Reviews

- We fixed an issue with the 301 Redirect feature where URLs that ends with /connect not being redirected as expected in some cases.

- We optimized the Google Autocomplete API feature in order to request more specific information which may lower the cost of using the API in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Google Location Suggest

- The Filter By Top Level Category dropdown on the Member Category page will now display the categories in alphabetical order.

- The Auto-Recurring Event Add-On is now fully compatible with the" Order Results By" Setting on the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin.

- Choosing a language using the Language Setting in the Configuration tab on the General Settings page of the Admin will now also update the language of PDF invoices generated by the site.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the "Write a Review" button on Member Profile pages to not display in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Header

- We fixed an issue which was causing "Hide Specialties Tab" Product Setting to not work properly when Member Profile pages are set to "Display Member Content Without Tabs". Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Member Tabs Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Member Tabs lazyLoad

- We resolved an issue that was displaying a backslash after apostrophes when included in the content of an Admin account.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the "View Preview" button to not work properly after a member creates a new Sub-Account in their Member Dashboard. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Edit
